name: whimprflow
description: Repo-root package manifest. Tauri resolves beforeBuildCommand/beforeDevCommand by walking up from src-tauri/ to the nearest package.json; without this file that walk leaves the repository entirely and lands on whatever package.json happens to sit in a parent directory (a home directory one is common), where `pnpm build` fails with "Command \"build\" not found". Anchoring the walk here makes the build independent of what surrounds the checkout, and the scripts delegate to ui/ so they are correct from either directory.
